# laravelcloud_websocket_clusters (Resource)

Manages a WebSocket cluster in Laravel Cloud.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "laravelcloud_websocket_clusters" "example" {
  max_connections = 1
  name            = "example-name"
  region          = "us-east-2"
  type            = "reverb"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `max_connections` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `region` (String)
- `type` (String)

### Optional

- `websocket_server` (String) The websocket server identifier

### Read-Only

- `connection_distribution_strategy` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `hostname` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import laravelcloud_websocket_clusters.example the-id
```
